programme.title: Panamá
programme.desc: Em 1989, numa época de turbulência profunda no Panamá, o ex-marine James Becker chega à paisana ao país para negociar um acordo que envolve armas de fogo, mas acaba por se ver envolvido na invasão americana do país e aprende uma lição fundamental sobre a natureza do poder político.

programme.title: A Memória De Um Assassino
programme.desc: Alex Lewis é um assassino profissional que se recusa a completar a missão de matar uma criança, o que o torna num alvo a abater. A sua única hipótese é perseguir aqueles que o querem matar, só que ele tem um desafio quase inultrapassável: está a perder a memória a um ritmo cada vez mais acelerado.

programme.title: The Reckoning - O Derradeiro Julgamento
programme.desc: A Grande Peste espalhou no país um clima de medo, desconfiança e morte. Grace, uma jovem viúva, é falsamente acusada de bruxaria pelo senhorio depois deste a tentar forçar a pagar as dívidas com favores sexuais. Levada para a prisão, ela enfrentará a mais cruel tortura, mas não estará sozinha...

programme.title: Dia De Tempestade
programme.desc: Um empresário americano vigarista tenta que o obscuro e influente dono de uma discoteca em Newcastle, na Inglaterra, lhe venda seu negócio. Mas um novo funcionário do clube e a ex-amante do americano apaixonam-se e, sem querer, tudo muda.

programme.title: Hotel Bitcoin
programme.desc: Um grupo de amigos precisa de sobreviver a um fim de semana num hotel enquanto guarda uma enorme quantia de dinheiro virtual, colocando à prova toda a sua astúcia e engenho.

programme.title: A Estrela Da Equipa
programme.desc: Dois jogadores britânicos de bowling na relva, um mais jovem e rebelde e outro mais velho e conservador, juntam-se muito a contra-gosto pela mão de um agente desportivo para concorrer contra uma equipa australiana.

programme.title: Revolução (Sem) Sangue
programme.desc: Baseado em factos reais, eis a história de quatro jovens que seguem as suas rotinas diárias num regime ditatorial. Embora não se conhecessem, o dia 25 de Abril de 1974 trouxe-lhes um destino comum. O dia que mudou o rumo do país ditou também o fim das suas vidas.

programme.title: Os Estagiários
programme.desc: Billy e Nick são vendedores cujas carreiras foram destruídas pela era digital. Na tentativa de provar que não estão obsoletos, conseguem um cobiçado estágio na Google, juntamente com um batalhão de pequenos génios. O problema é que eles são quase info-excluídos…

programme.title: Uma Casa Cheia
programme.desc: Alice Kinney vive em Los Angeles com as duas filhas. Com 40 anos e solteira, ela vai ver a sua vida sofrer uma grande reviravolta quando, a pedido da mãe, consente que três jovens atraentes vão viver temporariamente em sua casa.

programme.title: As Aventuras Do Dr. Dolittle
programme.desc: John Dolittle é um médico que consegue falar com animais e se lança numa aventura para encontrar uma ilha lendária com um jovem aprendiz e uma tripulações de estranha bicharada.

programme.title: Hora De Ponta 3
programme.desc: Após o embaixador chinês Solon Han ser alvo de uma tentativa de assassinato em Los Angeles, os agentes Lee e Chan vêem-se em Paris onde enfrentam vários desafios para tentar obter a lista de nomes dos líderes das Tríades responsáveis por esse e muitos outros crimes.

programme.title: Jogo Mortal
programme.desc: Marcus Jones é um agente da CIA enviado a Detroit para recolher informações que possam incriminar um negociante de armas e o responsável pelo fundo de investimento que o financia. Só que nem tudo corre pelo melhor, ele vai ser traído pelos colegas e terá de lutar pela própria vida.

programme.title: Alex Rider: Operação Stormbreaker
programme.desc: Após a morte do seu tio, que era um agente secreto e não um bancário como todos supunham, Alex Rider, um estudante de 14 anos, é forçado pela Divisão de Operações Especiais do MI6 a integrar uma missão que poderá salvar milhões de vidas.

programme.title: Bem Bom
programme.desc: 1979. Quatro jovens são contratadas para formar uma girl band. Elas sabem cantar, brilham a dançar e escandalizam o país… Elas tornam-se um fenómeno de popularidade. Elas são as Doce.

programme.title: Mergulho Profundo
programme.desc: Após um acidente natural, uma viagem de mergulho na Noruega torna-se numa corrida contra o tempo para duas irmãs. Enquanto uma fica presa no fundo do mar, a outra fará de tudo para tentar salvar a irmã antes que o oxigénio acabe.

programme.title: Força Em Alerta 2
programme.desc: Casey Ryback parte de férias com a sobrinha num comboio do Colorado a Los Angeles, só que, logo no início da viagem, um grupo de terroristas invade o veiculo para usá-lo como quartel general na captura de um satélite altamente secreto e extraordinariamente destrutivo.

programme.title: Órfã: A Origem
programme.desc: Depois de planear uma brilhante fuga de um hospital psiquiátrico na Estónia, Esther viaja até aos EUA passando-se pela filha desaparecida de uma família milionária. No entanto, após uma inesperada reviravolta, a mãe começa a desconfiar da “criança” assassina, e tudo faz para proteger a sua família.

programme.title: Os Ingleses Estão A Chegar
programme.desc: Harriet e Peter Fox são um casal de vigaristas ingleses que, após perderem uma grande soma ao póquer e ficarem a dever dinheiro a uma gangster psicótica, fogem para Los Angeles onde acabam por criar um elaborado plano para roubar um anel à rica ex-mulher de Peter.

programme.title: Delatora
programme.desc: Kathy Bolkovac é uma agente do Nebraska que vai trabalhar para as Nações Unidas como pacificadora na Bósnia. Só que a sua vontade de ajudar é arrasada ao deparar-se com uma vasta rede de corrupção e tráfico sexual encoberta pela instituição.

programme.title: Uma Nova Vida
programme.desc: Ben e Ava conheceram-se com apenas sete anos de idade e a sua relação evoluiu da amizade para o amor. Mas agora enquanto casal, um momento trágico pode condicionar todo o seu futuro.

programme.title: Homens Que Matam Cabras Só Com O Olhar
programme.desc: Um jornalista a cobrir a guerra no Iraque depara-se com aquela que pode ser a reportagem da sua vida, ao encontrar um homem que afirma ter pertencido a uma unidade militar americana que utiliza poderes paranormais nas suas missões.

programme.title: Scoop
programme.desc: Após um espetáculo de ilusionismo em Londres, Sondra, uma estudante norte-americana de jornalismo, apercebe-se que consegue ouvir a voz de um reporter já falecido, que a vai conduzir na investigação da identidade de um assassino, que poderá ser o aristocrata por quem ela se apaixonou.

programme.title: Parasitas
programme.desc: Uma família coreana no desemprego começa a ter um interesse peculiar por uma outra, com um estilo de vida cheio de glamour, até que todos se envolvem num acontecimento absolutamente inesperado.

programme.title: Zona 414
programme.desc: Num futuro próximo, numa colónia de robôs humanoides, o detetive particular David Carmichael é contratado para encontrar a filha desaparecida do excêntrico criador dos andróides que integram aquela comunidade.

programme.title: 10 Minutos
programme.desc: Rex é um mestre do crime que contrata Frank e a sua equipa para roubarem uma joia de valor inestimável. Só que algum deles sabotou o assalto, Frank é agredido e quando volta a si percebe que a joia desapareceu e não se lembra quem o atacou… E vai fazer de tudo para descobrir.

programme.title: Cidade Dividida
programme.desc: Na cidade de Nova Iorque, Billy Taggart, um ex-polícia caído em desgraça trabalha como investigador particular e é contratado pelo presidente da câmara de Nova Iorque, a quem deve um enorme favor, para espiar a sua mulher.

programme.title: Força Da Natureza
programme.desc: Uma quadrilha de ladrões planeia um assalto num velho complexo de apartamentos de Porto Rico quando um grande furacão se abate sobre o local. Mas a tarefa vai ser complicada por um polícia que lá está destacado para evacuar o local e um ex-polícia ansioso por voltar ao ativo.

programme.title: O Uivo
programme.desc: Numa noite de tempestade, o último comboio de Londres trava de emergência numa floresta. O maquinista sai para investigar e desaparece, os passageiros ficam em pânico ao ouvirem uivos vindos da escuridão e há uma criatura à solta que obriga a que todos se juntem para sobreviver.

programme.title: Contrato Para Matar
programme.desc: John Harmon, um agente da CIA, investiga um plano para usar as redes de tráfico de droga do México para fazer entrar armas e líderes extremistas nos EUA.

programme.title: Headhunters - Caçadores De Cabeças
programme.desc: De dia, Roger Brown é um caçador de talentos sem rival no mundo empresarial mas de noite é um ladrão de arte prolífero, com olho para grandes antiguidades. É nessa sua segunda vida que ele resolve ariscar tudo ao tentar roubar uma valiosa pintura a um antigo mercenário...

programme.title: Bucha Memória Ou Esquecimento
programme.desc: A história de um refugiado judeu do Cazaquistão que, na primavera de 2022, salvou centenas de ucranianos em Bucha e noutras cidades e vilas ocupadas pelas tropas russas.

programme.title: Verdi - Messa da Requiem
programme.desc: Roberto Abbado conducts the Filarmonica Arturo Toscanini, the Coro del Teatro Regio di Parma, and four vocal soloists in an outstanding performance of Giuseppe Verdi’s Messa da Requiem, recorded at the Parco Ducale di Parma, Italy as part of Festival Verdi 2020. The soloists are soprano Eleonora Buratto, mezzosoprano Anita Rachvelishvili, tenor Giorgio Berrugi, and bass Roberto Tagliavini.

programme.title: Waldbühne 1995 - American Night
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the Berlin Philharmonic Orchestra, which plays pieces by George Gershwin and Leonard Bernstein as part of a musical celebration of Americana. This concert was presented at the Waldbühne in Berlin, a green theatre based on the amphitheatre of the ancient Greek city of Epidaurus which is one of Berlin's favorite outdoor scenes because of its enchanting setting.

programme.title: The 12 Cellists - Documentary
programme.desc: Directed in 2012 by Enrique Sánchez Lansch, the documentary The 12 Cellists follows the 12 cellists of the Berlin Philharmonic Orchestra. Since 1972, this group is a staple of the international musical universe. Whether they play classical music, jazz, tango or avant-garde music, these talented musicians invariably enthrall audiences with the wide range of unique and bewitching sounds they produce with their cellos.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 4
programme.desc: The program is introduced with a short documentation about Schönberg's Pelleas et Melisande, based on a text by Claudio Abbado. Every musical theme relates to a special colour appearing on screen. What has been so remarkable about Abbado’s Mahler performances is that their impact has never been achieved at the expense of the multiple sensitivities, subtleties and extreme sophistication.

programme.title: IVC 2021 - Semi-finals: Fauré, Wolf a. o.
programme.desc: Soprano Alisa Fedorenko (Russia, 1999) and pianist Evgenii Sergeev (Russia, 1986) perform ‘Mandoline’ and ‘À Clymène’ from Gabriel Fauré’s Cinq melodies “de Venise”, Op. 58; ‘Lied der Delphine’ from Franz Schubert’s Zwei Szenen aus dem Schauspiel ‘Lacrimas’, D. 857; ‘Son’ (A dream) from Sergei Rachmaninoff’s Six Romances, Op.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mozart - Symphony No. 35, K. 385
programme.desc: Claudio Abbado conducts the Berlin Philharmonic in a performance of Mozart’s “Haffner” Symphony No. 35, K. 385, recorded during the very first Europakonzert in the Smetana Hall in Prague, 1991. Mozart originally composed the symphony as a serenade for the family of Sigmund Haffner, a childhood friend from Salzburg in 1782.

programme.title: Stravinsky - Le Sacre - I. L'Adoration de la Terre
programme.desc: Every year, the Europakonzert is hosted by the Berliner Philharmoniker in a notorious concert hall or on a special location. This years concert is performed at the magnificent Royal Albert Hall in London. The Dutch conductor Bernard Haitink closes with Stravinsky's The Rite of Spring which he wrote in 1913 for Sergei Diaghilev's Ballets Russes.

programme.title: Bach - Partitas for Solo Violin (BWV 1001-1006)
programme.desc: Gidon Kremer’s return to J. S. Bach’s partitas is a major event. Kremer’s first recording of these works was released almost a quarter of a century ago. In this recording from 2006, Kremer once again takes on the greatest challenge for any violinist: Bach’s magnificent “Sonatas and Partitas for Solo Violin” (BWV 1001-1006), which Kremer himself calls the “Himalayas” of violin music.

programme.title: IVC 2021 - Semi-finals: Ives, Brahms a. o.
programme.desc: Bass-baritone Matthias Hoffmann (Austria, 1991) and pianist Lisa Ochsendorf (Germany, 1991) perform ‘A. Very pleasant’ from Charles Ives’s song ‘Memories’; ‘Nachtwanderer’ from Hans Erich Pfitzner’s Fünf Lieder, Op. 7; ‘Nachts’ from Hans Sommer’s Zehn Lieder, Op. 9; ‘Da unten im Tale’ from Johannes Brahms’s Deutsche Volkslieder, WoO.

programme.title: Documentary 2017
programme.desc: This short documentary follows the participants of the 11th International Franz Liszt Piano Competition, held in TivoliVredenburg, Utrecht, in 2017. The competition actively presents, develops, and promotes piano talents from around the world. In doing so, it has become one of the prominent gateways to the international professional classical music scene for young musicians.

programme.title: Grieg - Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16
programme.desc: Conductor Jan Latham-Koenig leads the Flanders Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Edvard Grieg’s Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16. French pianist Pascal Amoyel features as the soloist. Grieg composed the work in 1868, drawing inspiration from Norwegian folk music. It is the composer’s only concerto. The work premiered on April 3, 1869 in Copenhagen, Denmark, with Edmund Neupert as the soloist, and was received enthusiastically.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Penderecki - Symphony No. 7: 7 Gates of Jerusalem
programme.desc: The 2017 Prague Spring festival is brought to a powerful close as Krzysztof Penderecki conducts the Prague Radio Symphony Orchestra and Slovak Philharmonic Choir in a performance of his monumental seventh symphony 'Seven Gates of Jerusalem'. This work bears witness to an introspective thought about faith, written in honour of the city of Jerusalem, for soloists, choir and orchestra, with libretto taken from Old Testament.

programme.title: Piano works by Rachmaninoff, Beethoven And Glazunov
programme.desc: Russian pianist Nikolay Lugansky has received world-wide praise for his interpretations of the music of Sergei Rachmaninoff. In this wonderful recital, the great pianist presents works by the Russian Romantic composer as well as Ludwig van Beethoven and Alexander Glazunov. Lugansky opens his concert with Beethoven’s Piano Sonata No. 14 in C-sharp minor, Op. 27 No. 2, ‘Moonlight’, followed by Alexander Glazunov’s Piano Sonata No.

programme.title: Documentary: Gianandrea Noseda
programme.desc: Although the great Italian composer Giuseppe Verdi applied unsuccessfully to study at the Milan Conservatory, this renowned college of music was eventually named after him. Today, the ‘Conservatorio Giuseppe Verdi’ counts numerous successful musicians among its alumni: from Giacomo Puccini, Alfredo Catalani, Claudio Abbado, Riccardo Chailly, Luigi Einaudi and Daniele Gatti, to Gianandrea Noseda.

programme.title: Villa-Lobos - String Quartet No. 17
programme.desc: Quarteto Radamés Gnattali performs Heitor Villa-Lobos's String Quartet No. 17 at the Palácio das Laranjeiras in Rio de Janiero, Brasil. The ensemble was founded in 2006 and consists of Carla Rincón and Francisco Roa (violins), Fernando Thebaldi (viola), and Hugo Pilger (cello). The quartet, which specializes in Brazilian music, focuses on educational activities.

programme.title: Bachfest 2010
programme.desc: András Schiff (Budapest, 1953) is one of the world's most distinguished pianists, breathing life into pieces with sheer magic. Schiff, a guardian of almost-forgotten ideals of piano playing, is more than a great pianist: he is an expert with insight that goes beyond the piano music, delving deeper into the wider field and macro culture.

programme.title: Mussorgsky - Night on Bald Mountain
programme.desc: Young Euro Classic is the world’s most important platform for international young orchestra musicians in the European classical music tradition, and for its development. For 17 days every summer, orchestras from all over the world perform at Berlin’s Konzerthaus, on Gendarmenmarkt. This performance features some highlights of the Young Euro Classic edition of 2016.

programme.title: Giselle
programme.desc: Choreographed by Charles Jude, the ballet Giselle by Jean Coralli and Jules Perrot, with music by Adolphe Adam, tells the story of a lovely peasant girl by the same name. Giselle was first presented at Théâtre de l'Académie Royale de Musique in Salle Le Peletier in Paris on June 28, 1841. The story is set in the Rhineland of the Middle Ages during the grape harvest. Giselle falls in love with Albrecht, the Duke of Silesia.

programme.title: Works by Gluck, Bach and Mozart
programme.desc: Venezuelan-born conductor Giovanni Guzzo leads the Camerata Fundación EDP of the Reina Sofía School of Music in a spirited concert. The program opens with the ethereal ‘Danza degli spiriti beati’ (Dance of the Blessed Spirits) from Christoph Willibald Gluck’s opera Orfeo ed Euridice, featuring flutist Matthew Raymond Origel. The concert continues with vocal masterworks, including J.S.

programme.title: Mahler - Rückert Songs
programme.desc: The Rückert-Lieder are a collection of five art songs by Mahler, set to poems by Friedrich Rückert, showcasing his gift for intimate and deeply personal musical expression in a style that balances simplicity with profound emotional complexity, often exploring themes of nature, loss, and transcendence.

programme.title: Mozart - Piano Concerto No. 14, KV 449
programme.desc: Regarded as one of the finest interpreters of Romantic repertoire, Francesco Attesti (*1975) gave his first recital at age 11 and by the time he was 23, had earned the highest honours in piano from Florence’s Conservatorio Luigi Cherubini. In this recording of his 2016 Deeply Mozart concert tour, Attesti performs Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s piano concertos KV 449 and KV 488 with the Italian OIDA Orchestra and conductor Paolo Belloli.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 8 in F major, Op. 93
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 8 in F major, Op. 93. Beethoven wrote the work in 1812 upon completion of his Symphony No. 7. The composer conducted the February 27, 1814 première at a concert in Vienna that also included a reprise performance of his Symphony No.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Chopin - Piano Concertos No. 1 And No. 2
programme.desc: Antoni Wit conducts the Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra in performances of Chopin's Piano Concertos No. 1, Op. 11 and No. 2, Op. 21. Soloists are Nikolai Demidenko and Evgeny Kissin. After performing the first concerto, Demidenko encores with Chopin's Mazurka Op. 17/4. Kissin closes the concert with Chopin's Etude Op. 10/12 and the Waltz in E minor, Op. post. This concert was part of the celebration of Chopin's 200th anniversary in 2010.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Symphony No. 6 in B minor, Op. 74
programme.desc: This concert may be called a meeting of musical giants: Manfred Honeck conducts the Berlin Philharmonic while cellist Yo-Yo Ma features as soloist. Success guaranteed when these artists take the stage at the 2016 Easter Concert from the Festspielhaus in Baden-Baden! Honeck, musical director of the Pittsburgh Symphony Orchestra, made his successful debut with the Berlin Philharmonic in 2013.

programme.title: Rachmaninoff - Sonata for Cello, Op. 19
programme.desc: Italian cellist Silvia Chiesa and Italian pianist Maurizio Baglini perform Sergei Rachmaninoff’s Sonata in G minor for cello and piano, Op. 19. This performance was recorded at Sala Verdi of the Conservatorio Giuseppe Verdi in Milan, Italy, on November 4, 2024.

programme.title: Puccini - Tosca
programme.desc: For the Easter Festival 2017 in Baden-Baden, Sir Simon Rattle and the Berliner Philharmoniker draw their inspiration from Tosca, the most well-known and most brilliant of all the Puccini operas. And that is deservedly so since Tosca is not merely a work of art, but also a gripping suspense-packed story. The opera premiered in 1900 at the Teatro Costanzi in Rome.

programme.title: The Berlin Philharmonic in Tokyo
programme.desc: The Berliner Philharmoniker is one of the world’s finest orchestras, its fame stretching all the way to Japan. Unsurprisingly, this 2000 concert, recorded at Tokyo’s magnificent Suntory Hall, was a resounding success. Mariss Jansons conducts a beautiful program that includes Antonin Dvorák’s Symphony No. 8, Carl Maria von Weber’s Overture to Oberon, and Dmitri Shostakovich’s Violin Concerto featuring star violinist Hilary Hahn (*1979).

programme.title: Modena - City of Belcanto
programme.desc: This documentary by Mark Perna shows the training and professional growth actions for opera singers, the promotion and enhancement of the cultural offer of the city and province of Modena and the maintenance and development of the Modenese musical tradition in the field of opera.

programme.title: Brahms - Violin Concerto
programme.desc: Israeli violinist Itzhak Perlman and the Berlin Philharmonic perform Johannes Brahms' Violin Concerto (1833-1897) under the direction of Daniel Barenboim. After Beethoven's Violin Concerto, Brahms' piece is probably the most famous German Violin Concerto ever written. These two works have much in common, especially the tone in D major in which they were composed.

programme.title: IVC 2021 - Final: Diepenbrock, Fauré a. o.
programme.desc: Tenor Zhuohan Sun (China, 1993) and pianist Sara Pavlovic (Serbia, 1996) perform ‘Wanderlied’ from Robert Schumann’s Kerner-Lieder, Op. 35; ‘Der Abend kommt gezogen’ from Alphons Diepenbrock’s Drie ballades, Op. 1; Gabriel Fauré’s Prison, Op. 83, No. 1; ‘Ganymed’ from Hugo Wolf’s Goethe-Lieder; Franz Schubert’s Nacht und Träume, D. 827; Zaiyi Lu’s The bridge in my homeland; ‘Mit Myrten und Rosen’ from Schumann’s Liederkreis, Op.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Sounds like Christmas
programme.desc: Set in the magnificent Cistercian Monastery Schulpforte near Naumburg, Germany, Sounds like Christmas combines festive music with the spontaneity and freshness of jazz. This Christmas program is the musical encounter between soprano Angelika Kirchschlager and jazz trumpeter Tomasz Stanko.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concerto No. 5
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021.

programme.title: A Mozart Concert from Berlin
programme.desc: The Carl Philipp Emanuel Bach Chamber Orchestra delivers a program entirely devoted to Mozart at the Konzerthaus in Berlin under the direction of Hartmut Haenchen. In reduced form, the ensemble manages to bring to life the many characteristics of the music and the unique spirit of the famous composer, be it his gaiety of heart, his lyricism, his dramatic side or his polyphonic writing inspired.

programme.title: IVC 2021 - Semi-finals: Debussy, Haydn a. o.
programme.desc: Soprano Isabel Weller (Germany, 1994) and pianist Yuriko Watanabe (Japan, 1994) perform Claude Debussy’s Nuit d’étoiles, L. 2, and Mandoline, L. 43; Joseph Haydn’s Piercing eyes, Hob. XXVIa, No. 35; ‘Die Mainacht’ from Johannes Brahms’s Vier Gesänge, Op. 43; ‘Pietà’ from Paul Hindemith’s Das Marienleben, Op.

programme.title: Teatro Regio behind the scenes
programme.desc: Few Italian theatres can boast of being an absolute point of reference for national and world culture. The Teatro Regio in Turin is both a symbol of excellence in the national operatic tradition and a prestigious stage hosting operas, ballets, concerts, and musicals of great substance.

programme.title: Schubert - Rondo D. 951
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored chamber music repertoire in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists. As part of this concert, Argerich and pianist Iddo Bar-Shaï perform Franz Schubert’s Rondo in A major, D. 951.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: In the Organ's Stomach
programme.desc: Olivier Latry is the current holder of the Great Organ of Notre Dame. Between its original religious function and the interest of composers of all times, the great organ Cavaillé-Coll reveals its absolute modernity. Latry is considered one of the greatest organists of his generation, both in France and internationally.

programme.title: Shusha Renaissance (2023)
programme.desc: “Shusha, the Renaissance” is a musical journey featuring pianist Murad Huseynov. The city of Shusha is often considered the cradle of Azerbaijan's music and poetry and one of the leading centres of the Azerbaijani culture, having been declared the cultural capital of Azerbaijan in January 2021. On the program are the following works: Fikret Amirov’s (1922-1984) Twelve Miniatures for Piano Solo: I. Ballade - II. Ashigsayagi – III.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 4 in B-flat major, Op. 60
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances perform Ludwig van Beethoven’s Symphony No. 4 in B-flat major, Op. 60. Count Franz von Oppersdorff, who adored Beethoven’s Symphony No.

programme.title: Works for lute by J. S. Bach
programme.desc: French lutenist Thomas Dunford performs various works for lute by J. S. Bach in this intimate chamber music concert, recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, in 2017. On the program are Suite for lute in G minor, BWV 995; Suite for solo cello in G major (arr. for lute), BWV 1007; and Chaconne from Partita for solo violin in D minor (arr. lute), BWV 1004.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 1, Op. 15
programme.desc: At the age of seven, Martha Argerich made her debut with Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 1, a piece that would accompany her throughout her career. In this concert at the Lucerne Festival, the celebrated pianist performs the signature piece with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra under the baton of Swedish conductor Herbert Blomstedt, who made his debut here with the orchestra.

programme.title: Ladies first, From Marian motet to love song
programme.desc: Despite his motto ‘Aultre n’auray’ (‘I shall never have another’), Philip the Good was known for his passion for the fairer sex. Could this explain why Le Champion des Dames – Martin le Franc’s monumental poem about famous women – was dedicated to Philip?

programme.title: Europakonzert 2012 - Vienna
programme.desc: Every year, the Berliner Philharmoniker commemorate their founding in 1883 with the Europa Konzert at a venue of cultural importance in a different European city. This year, the Berliner Philharmoniker under the baton of internationally acclaimed conductor Gustavo Dudamel welcomes one of the world's leading young cellists, Gautier Capuçon. On the program are Johannes Brahms' Variations on a Theme by Haydn in B flat Major, Op.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 2
programme.desc: Mahler's 'Resurrection' Symphony, written between 1888 and 1894, is a colossal five-movement work exploring themes of death and resurrection. It was one of Mahler's most popular and acclaimed works during his lifetime, famously culminating in a powerful choral finale.

programme.title: Gala from Berlin - 2009
programme.desc: At the gala concert of 2009, the Berlin Philharmonic under its musical director Sir Simon Rattle and Lang Lang present works by two Russian composers. The concert starts with a performance of Rachmaninov's Piano Concerto No. 2 in C minor, Op. 18, one of the composer’s most enduring popular pieces, which demands a virtuoso pianist and a huge supple orchestral sound.

programme.title: Solos for Clarinet, Part I
programme.desc: The great clarinettist Paolo Beltramini plays a program of solo pieces for clarinet on Stingray Brava. In this broadcast, Beltramini performs C.P.E. Bach’s Solfeggietto, Béla Kovàc’s Hommage à Paganini, and Igor Stravinsky’s Three Pieces for Clarinet Solo. Paolo Beltramini is the only Italian clarinettist to have won first prize at the prestigious Prague Spring International Clarinet Competition (1996).

programme.title: Summertime at the Domaine Forget
programme.desc: The documentary Summertime at the Domaine Forget introduces internationally renowned treasure: Domaine Forget festival in Saint-Irénée, Québec. Domaine Forget is one of Canada's leading music academies and hosts this annual festival to promote music and dance.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Symphony No. 2, Op. 17
programme.desc: The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy’s oldest opera and arts festival. It was founded in 1933 with the aim of presenting contemporary and forgotten operas. Over the years, the scope widened, and orchestral concerts have long been an integral part of the festival.

programme.title: Tribute to Hans van Manen
programme.desc: Dutch choreographer Hans van Manen (1932) is internationally recognized as one of the grand masters of contemporary ballet. His over 150 ballets all bear his distinct signature, featuring a great clarity in structure, refined simplicity and an aversion to decorative frills. In this tribute to the great choreographer, dancers of the Dutch National Ballet perform three masterpieces from Van Manen’s extensive oeuvre.

programme.title: Bizet - Symphony in C
programme.desc: Enjoy a sparkling performance of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s famous Piano Concerto No. 1, by the incredible piano virtuoso Russian Daniil Trifonov, with Kent Nagano conducting the Israel Philharmonic Orchestra, to prove once more how majestic and incredible classical music can be when it’s done right! The concert opens with the famous Air from Bach's Orchestral Suite No. 3.

programme.title: Monteverdi - Madrigals, Book I
programme.desc: Italian composer Claudio Monteverdi (1567-1643) composed nine books of madrigals in half a century, which helped transform the genre from the polyphonic, a cappella madrigals of the late Renaissance to the ‘concertato’ madrigals of the early Baroque, shifting the style’s focus to the ability of music to express emotions contained in a text.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Thomas - Hamlet
programme.desc: Hamlet is a grand opera in five acts by the French composer Ambroise Thomas (1811-1896), with a libretto by Michel Carré and Jules Barbier. It is based on a French adaptation by Alexandre Dumas and Paul Meurice of Shakespeare's Hamlet. Thomas’ operas Mignon (1866) and Hamlet (1868) were largely neglected during the 20th century but experienced somewhat of a revival over the last decades.

programme.title: The spirits of Mozart
programme.desc: A crossover experience inspired by the music of Mozart: the surprising and original Spirits of Mozart. In this crossover concert, outstanding personalities from the fields of pop, jazz and classical music interpret Mozart`s compositions in their personal musical languages for a broad public of the 21st century. These performances show that the impact of Mozart`s music reaches far beyond the boundaries of classical music.

programme.title: Patmos – A musical documentary
programme.desc: Every summer, the Greek island of Patmos hosts the Patmos Musical Festival, a unique musical event comprising both a Chamber and a Sacred Music Festival. This documentary captures the 2024 edition, featuring performances by distinguished soloists and ensembles from around the world.

programme.title: Ovos de Ouro
programme.desc: Benito González trabalha na construção civil em Melilla e sonha grande: construir no edifício mais alto em Benidorm um grande símbolo fálico de poder, as Torres González.Ao longo de vários anos, vemos a ascensão e queda de Benito, bem como a construção da sua torre. Através de uma personalidade bem forte, ele aproveita-se financeiramente das mulheres com quem está envolvido.

programme.title: Língua Mãe T6 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: No ‘Língua Mãe’, Luís Represas sai em busca dos autores portugueses. Gente que escreve, compõe, pinta, encena, sempre no seu próprio mundo solitário, por vezes desconhecido de quem não vê TV, rádio, internet, exposições, passagens de modelos ou de quem não tem hábitos de leitura. De Macau a Timor, de Angola a São Tomé e Príncipe, de Cabo Verde a Moçambique, da Guiné ao Brasil, estes autores têm um denominador comum: a língua portuguesa.

programme.title: O Círculo - Ep. 15
programme.desc: Dois jovens, Cihangir e Kaan, são atraídos para um jogo mortal gerido por uma organização criminosa chamada O Círculo. Trocados à nascença por líderes da máfia, crescem sem conhecer as suas verdadeiras identidades. Anos mais tarde, os seus caminhos voltam a cruzar-se enquanto lutam pela justiça e pelo amor, enredados numa teia de segredos, traição e poder.

programme.title: Segure Minha Mão T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: A história gira em torno de uma garota chamada Azra, que está estudando no exterior, na América, para se tornar cozinheira profissional, assim como seu pai.

programme.title: Ressurreição: Ertugru T2 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: Na segunda temporada, a tribo Kayi alia-se aos clãs turcomanos para resistir à invasão mongol. Ertugrul é capturado e torturado, mas escapa e regressa para enfrentar a traição, o exílio e planos maquiavélicos. Expõe conspirações, resgata o seu filho, derrota Noyan e leva o seu povo para oeste para fundar um novo estado.

programme.title: O Jogo do Destino - Ep. 49
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

Anos mais tarde, os seus caminhos voltam a cruzar-se enquanto lutam pela justiça e pelo amor, enredados numa teia de segredos, traição e poder.

Expõe conspirações, resgata o seu filho, derrota Noyan e leva o seu povo para oeste para fundar um novo estado.

programme.title: 10th Anniversary: JazzArt Orchestra And Friends
programme.desc: Jazz, funk, or soul: the JazzArt Orchestra tackles each genre without batting an eye. One of the orchestra’s ambitions is to cooperate with other art disciplines, and to contribute to the local cultural climate in the East of the Netherland. Recently, JazzArt has agreed with Odeon Theatres in Zwolle, the Netherlands, to play two concerts a year at the Odeon Theatre.

programme.title: Episode 1: Thelonious Monk - Jazz Greats
programme.desc: The idiosyncratic pianist and composer Thelonious Monk (1917-1982) is one of the all-time greats of jazz. His music went largely misunderstood for the first 15 years of his career, after which he was rightly hailed as a genius, and received credit as a founding father of bebop.

programme.title: SHYRE live at Festival Vue sur la Relève
programme.desc: SHYRE is the creative collaboration launched by Montreal-born vocalist and pianist Sarah Rossy. This five-member group mixes instrumental textures with ethereal ambience, taking the listener on a journey through passages of prose with unique aesthetics. SHYRE fuses pop-folk and jazz with symphonic timbres, and psychedelic ambience, employing lush strings, dynamic rhythms, and angelic harmonies.

programme.title: Episode 2: Dizzy Gillespie - Jazz Greats
programme.desc: American jazz trumpeter, composer, and bandleader Dizzy Gillespie (1917-1993) was one of the seminal figures of the bebop movement. He fuses all musical forms rooted in African culture, such as music from Cuba, Latin America and the Caribbean, into his music.

programme.title: Dave Brubeck Quartet - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. The Dave Brubeck Quartet gave an unforgettable performance at the North Sea Jazz Festival of 1982.

programme.title: The Morgenland Festival: Blossom
programme.desc: Since 2005, the Morgenland Festival of Osnabrueck has dedicated itself to the fascinating music culture of the Near and Middle East. From traditional and classical music to avant-garde, jazz, and rock, the festival program also features art, such as visual arts, dance, and theatre of interdisciplinary projects. The Morgenland Chamber Orchestra has been an integral part of the Morgenland Festival since 2009.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Thomas Carbou: Spectacle Au Bleury
programme.desc: Thomas Carbou and Patrick Graham share an almost telepathic rapport, blending spontaneous improvisation, electronic looping, and Brazilian and Indian musical influences to create ecstatic groove pieces and dream-like soundscapes.

programme.title: Les McCann: Live in New Orleans
programme.desc: Self-taught musician Les McCann became the international jazz superstar he is today after the release of his album “Swiss Movement” which he recorded in 1968 with the late Eddie Harris. Yet there is much more to this musician than that one record.

programme.title: Face au Public: Chuck Berry
programme.desc: No early breakthrough rock And roll artist is more important to the development of the genre than Chuck Berry (1926-2017). Influenced by jazz and rhythm and blues, he was rock And roll's greatest songwriter, the main shaper of its instrumental voice, one of its greatest guitarists, and one of its greatest performers.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Chucho Valdes - Jazz a Vienne
programme.desc: ‘Jazz a Vienne’ is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981 it has attracted leading jazz artists, with many of them playing return engagements. Unsurprisingly, the festival's 2013 edition did not fall short of expectations: the lineup was filled with the biggest names in music. Among them were Chucho Valdes and his Afro-Cuban Messengers, the prime example of Latin-inspired jazz music.

programme.title: Michelle David - Jazz in Duketown
programme.desc: Jazz in Duketown is the largest free outdoor jazz festival in the Netherlands. It's a real gathering for jazz addicts, inviting internationally renowned artists. The talented American singer Michelle David performs pop and gospel music that feeds the heart and soothes the soul. Having grown up with the church, she started singing at the age of four. A year later she joined her first band, The Mission of Love.

programme.title: Etienne Mbappe - Jazzwoche Burghausen
programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city.

programme.title: Visions of Music: Carnet des Routes
programme.desc: Visions of Music - World Jazz invites the viewer on a journey to the roots of music, introducing the enormous impact that traditional music from around the world has had on contemporary jazz. This program features legendary musicians such as BB King, Dino Saluzzi, Tito Puente, Carlos Santana, Zawinul Joe, Manu Dibango, Abdullah Ibrahim, as well as new generation representatives such as Nicholas Payton, Cyro Baptista, and Don Byron.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Paradox Live: James Brandon Lewis
programme.desc: Innovative contemporary jazz and improvised music, the search for modernity, mind blowing sounds, rock and pop… Indeed PARADOX Tilburg goes beyond jazz, crossing musical boundaries into the unknown soundscapes of electronic music. Indie artists, blues veterans and jazz superstars all pour their hearts and souls at the Paradox.

programme.title: George Shearing: The South Bank Show
programme.desc: George Shearing, blind since birth, is one of the world's greatest jazz pianists. Filmed on both sides of the Atlantic, this tribute to Shearing showcases the music which took the jazz world by storm.

programme.title: Tribute to Django Reinhardt: Rosenberg meets Beets
programme.desc: World-class Dutch jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson, and John Clayton. His mother a music teacher and his father an Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey enthusiast, Beets was surrounded by music from an early age.

programme.title: Jimmy Witherspoon Quartet And Rozaa Wortham 1985
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. Jimmy Witherspoon and Rozaa Wortham, two incredible brilliant jazz musicians. Rozaa Wortham starts off the show with the Jimmy Witherspoon Quartet.

programme.title: Edina Mokus - WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. In 2018, WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria.

programme.title: O.P. Trio and E. Fitz. - Jazz At The Philharmonic
programme.desc: The Royal Concertgebouw in Amsterdam is a world-renowned concert hall, known for its first-rate acoustics. It has attracted many famous performers over the years and is one of the Netherlands' most treasured musical institutions. On May 5, 1957, jazz impresario Norman Granz presented his Jazz at the Philharmonic tour at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam.

programme.title: MotorMusic: Hamster Axis of the one-click Panther
programme.desc: The MotorMusic Studios in Mechelen, Belgium, attract many great musicians to the city. A wide variety of visiting international jazz musicians share their art of making jazz music with the DJAZZ series ‘Belgium Sessions’. In these sessions, some of Europe’s finest musicians perform their own, original music.

programme.title: Josh Evans - Ballad Of Ernie Washington
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn’ at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, RAndB, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Time Track
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: Ellen Pels - Love 2/2
programme.desc: Dutch jazz singer Ellen Pels presents her latest release, “Love.” Recorded live at Theater Odeon in Zwolle, the Netherlands, Ellen is joined by The Red Limo String Quartet and her own nine-piece rhythm section. The singer combines her passionate love for music with her own, stirring lyrics, inspired by spiritual philosophers like Paulo Coelho, Eckhard Tolle, and Deepak Chopra.

programme.title: Kurhaus Scheveningen: Beets And Rosenwinkel
programme.desc: The Dutch world-class jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats like Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson and John Clayton. From birth, Beets was surrounded by music: he heard classical music from his mother, who is a music pedagogue, and he heard jazz from his father, who has a great fan of Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey.

programme.title: Brazilian Stomp
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1987, prominent guitarist George Benson brought his band to kick off day three of the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Whatever
programme.desc: In 1988, Dee Dee Bridgewater was one of the first great jazz singers to perform at the Jazz Festival in Ramatuelle. In 2016, the story seems to repeat itself as her daughter China Moses took the stage at Ramatuelle. Over the years, China Moses has become a mature performer with a unique style: rocky voice, sharp sense of swing, and intense/energetic stage presence.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Ode to Miles: Bitches Brew Beyond
programme.desc: For the 40th anniversary of jazz legend Miles Davis' legendary album Bitches Brew, trumpeter Wallace Roney leads a band that revives the master's music. This project is the brainchild of Miles' family (including his son Erin), which is represented by his nephew, drummer Vince Wilburn. This concert at the ancient theater in Vienne, France, is a grand tribute to Miles.

programme.title: Soul Makossa: Manu Dibango in Stuttgart
programme.desc: Manu Dibango, one of Africa’s biggest musical stars and top saxophonists, is an indispensable artist. He was one of the first African musicians to score a worldwide hit with his 1972 release “Soul Makossa”, paving the way for many other artists. The very concept of world music owes much to him.

programme.title: Anne Chris: Just Kissed The Sun
programme.desc: What happens when two musicians are 'trapped' on a cruise ship for a week? Naturally, a new album sees the light of day - at least that’s what happened when Anne Chris and pianist Daan Herweg found themselves on a journey by ship together. After a week of providing their fellow passengers with musical entertainment, the two headed to the studio and within a year, Anne Chris’s new album Just Kissed the Sun saw its release.

programme.title: Franco Ambrosetti Quintet live at Estival Lugano
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. The composer, trumpeter and bugle player Franco Ambrosetti performs with his quintet in his native Lugano as part of the Estival.

programme.title: Aki Rissanen Trio at Jazzclub Unterfahrt, Munich
programme.desc: Aki Rissanen's interest in jazz came after he started taking classical piano lessons. His deep interest in improvised music placed him among top jazz pianist in his home country - Finland. While composing and performing his own music, Rissanen has also collaborated with Verneri Pohjola and Dave Liebman, and today his name appears among the top European jazz musicians.

programme.title: Great Guitarists - Collage
programme.desc: This selection of unforgettable performances by some of the most iconic and influential jazz guitarists in history showcases these legends’ unique essence. Revel in Wes Montgomery’s virtuosity as he performs the captivating “Nica's Dream” in Holland in 1965, and delight in the expressive beauty of his rendition of “Here's That Rainy Day”, recorded in London in that same year.

programme.title: Brooks Bowman/Jazzmeia Horn, East Of The Sun
programme.desc: Vocalist Jazzmeia Horn’s 2019 Malta Jazz Festival appearance was a celebration of jazz’s future, infused with the soul of its past. Featuring Keith Brown (piano), Rashaan Carter (bass), Irwin Hall (flute and saxophone), and Anwar Marshall (drums), the young singer’s performance was a reminder of jazz’s enduring power to speak to the heart.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Songs She Never Heard
programme.desc: In 2019, the vibrant city of Sofia, Bulgaria, hosted the International A to JazZ Festival. Among the featured acts was the trailblazing jazz trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah. This genre-defying artist captivated the audience with his eclectic “stretch music”; an approach that incorporates hip-hop and reaches back through the American canon into African percussion and its rich melodic content.

programme.title: The Tällberg Foundation: 'Jazz for the Planet'
programme.desc: On October 19, 2021, John Patitucci (bass), Marco Pignataro (sax and musical director), and Joe Lovano (sax) showcased inspirational new originals at GBH's Fraser Performance Studio in Boston, MA, accompanied by Terri Lyne Carrington (drums), Nadia Washington (vocals), Chico Pinheiro (guitar), and Anastassiya Petrova (piano).

programme.title: Georgie Fame And the Blue Flames
programme.desc: Georgie Fame, known for 'Yeh, Yeh' and 'The Ballad of Bonnie and Clyde' makes a triumphant comeback with The Blue Flames. Georgie Fame and the Blue Flames was a popular band in the UK in the '60s, celebrated for its RAndB, soul, jazz, ska, and pop sounds. The training was largely inspired by ska, a popular musical style in Jamaican cafes in London at the time.

programme.title: Charles Mingus And Eric Dolphy live in Liège
programme.desc: Charles Mingus showcases an exceptional concert performed in April 1965 featuring his most celebrated lineup: Jaki Byard (piano), Dannie Richmond (drums), Johnny Coles (trumpet), Clifford Jordan (tenor sax) and the great Eric Dolphy (alto sax, flute and bass clarinet).

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Freddie Hubbard Quintet in Brussels, 1980
programme.desc: By the time this set was recorded at Brussels Jazz Club in the summer of 1980, trumpeter Freddie Hubbard had already built an impressive resume. During the 1960s he became a leading voice in the hard bop movement while not shying away from avant-garde sessions with the likes of John Coltrane and Eric Dolphy.

programme.title: PC Qwintett: 75th year of Courbois
programme.desc: Pierre Courbois has been one of Europe’s leading jazz musicians since the mid-sixties. This concert, recorded at the renowned Amsterdam jazz club Bimhuis, sees the drummer playing with his QWINTETT. On the occasion of his 75th birthday in 2015, Courbois hit the road for the Pierre Courbois 75 Years Anniversary Tour.

programme.title: Sun Ra Arkestra - Estival Jazz Lugano
programme.desc: Estival Jazz Lugano is an annual open-air music festival that takes place over five days at the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. On July 3, 1985, pianist and space-faring jazz icon Sun Ra and his Arkestra crash-landed at Estival Jazz Lugano.

programme.title: Chucho's Mood
programme.desc: Legendary Cuban pianist Chucho Valdés brought his band ‘Jazz Batá 2’ to the Malta Jazz Festival on July 19, 2019. The air was thick with anticipation as Valdés took to the stage, revisiting the small-group concept of his mythical 1972 Cuban album ‘Jazz Bata´’. The bata´ repertoire – the deep classical music of West Africa – permeates Valde´s’ piano solos throughout the concert.

programme.title: Flying Home
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1979, American singer Ella Fitzgerald gave an unforgettable performance at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Charles Lloyd Quartet live in Brussels
programme.desc: Since 1960, the legendary saxophonist Charles Lloyd has lent his adventurous, lyrical sound to collaborations with likes of Cannonball Adderley, Keith Jarrett and The Beach Boys. His early and highly successful experiments blending jazz and rock music charted a path that led to the electric fusion of Miles Davis and The Headhunters, while his exploration of spirituality and transcendental meditation added a new depth to his sound.

programme.title: John Coltrane: Live in Comblain-la-Tour
programme.desc: The mere mention of the name John Coltrane evokes a deeply emotional, often spiritual response from even the most casual jazz fan. Dexter Gordon was a fantastic saxophonist. Miles Davis was a genius. Coltrane stood above - he was a visionary, a saint-like figure. By the standards of most jazz musicians, his life was uneventful.

programme.title: Vocal Acrobats: Passion of an Improvised Journey
programme.desc: One vocalist from Paris and the other from Bern, and two contrasting personalities. Brought together by a chance encounter in 2014, the two singers were surprised to discover how much they had in common: they both do more than just sing well. Leïla Martial and Andreas Schaerer intend to explore and experiment, stretching their vocal boundaries.

programme.title: Samba das Flores - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor.

programme.title: Live at Beck’s Festival Bar
programme.desc: The UK based band Metronomy started out as a bedroom project by Joseph Mount, who during its early stages was the sole contributor to the band's repertoire. After the debut release, Mount started expanding the band's personnel: first by adding two members, and later increasing it by one more.

programme.title: Gregory Porter at the Blue Note Festival
programme.desc: Unlike many of his fellow jazz cats, vocalist Gregory Porter transcends the jazz bubble. After sustaining a shoulder injury, this former American football player turned to jazz singing. He was discovered in a Californian jazz club by pianist, saxophonist and composer Kamau Kenyatta. Porter lent his vocal skills to gospel choirs across the country and a string of successful musicals before turning his talent to his own compositions.

programme.title: Hall And Oates - Live at Sydney Entertainment Centre
programme.desc: When Daryl Hall and John Oates took to the stage at Sydney’s Entertainment Centre as the iconic bass line of ‘Maneater’ began to play, the fans knew they were in for a treat. This duo may have been opening concerts with that irresistibly smooth number for years, but it never seems to lose its magic, and the crowd – an eclectic mix of teens and baby boomers alike – lapped it up.

programme.title: Moondog And The London Saxophonique
programme.desc: Moondog, a gaunt, mysterious and extravagantly-garbed blind street musician was celebrated among New Yorkers for two decades before gaining acclaim in Europe as an avant-garde composer conducting orchestras before royalty. Artists such as Charlie Parker, Leonard Bernstein, Steve Reich and Philip Glass have called him one of the great musical visionaries of our century.?Day in and day out, the man whose real name is Louis T.

programme.title: Paradox Live: Bertus Borgers And The Young Retro's
programme.desc: Innovative contemporary jazz and improvised music, the search for modernity, mind blowing sounds, rock and pop… Indeed PARADOX Tilburg goes beyond jazz, crossing musical boundaries into the unknown soundscapes of electronic music. Indie artists, blues veterans and jazz superstars all pour their hearts and souls at the Paradox.

programme.title: Woody Herman's Swinging Herd live in England 1964
programme.desc: Woody Herman: Live in '64 features a blistering one-hour concert from 1964 showcasing one of the very hottest line-ups of the 'Swinging Herd,' including trumpeter Bill Chase, trombonist Phil Wilson, and the amazing saxophonist Sal Nistico on the front line, as well as drummer Jake Hanna, bassist Chuck Andrus, and pianist-arranger Nat Pierce in the rhythm section.

programme.title: TorTube: La Waltz 2, 3 and More
programme.desc: Jazz fans in television land have come to the right place for their dose of first-rate world jazz: TorTube! Jazz club De Tor in Enschede is one of Europe’s most authentic jazz venues, with an absolutely unique ambiance. Some of the best musicians from Holland and the rest of the world find their way to De Tor to perform for an appreciative audience of jazz fans.

programme.desc: Um polícia de Chicago é apanhado no meio de uma guerra de gangs, enquanto os seus próprios camaradas o evitam porque ele quer acabar com um polícia irresponsável.

programme.title: Robocop, o Polícia do Futuro
programme.desc: Em Detroit, uma organização cria um polícia robot para substituir os polícias normais, mas um executivo pretende tirar partido em benefício próprio.

programme.title: Os Três Mosqueteiros: Milady
programme.desc: Os mosqueteiros decidem unir forças com a misteriosa Milady para colocar seus inimigos fora de ação, enquanto o Reino da França é dividido por guerras religiosas e permanece sob ameaça britânica.

programme.title: Lassie De Volta A Casa
programme.desc: Conta a história de Lassie, uma cadela collie, que é vendida pela sua família por dificuldades financeiras, mas foge e embarca numa longa e perigosa jornada para voltar para casa e reencontrar seu dono, Joe.

programme.title: O Príncipe Volta a Nova Iorque
programme.desc: O monarca africano Akeem descobre que tem um filho há muito perdido nos Estados Unidos e deve retornar à América para conhecer esse herdeiro inesperado e construir um relacionamento com seu filho.

programme.title: Barbie
programme.desc: A Barbie e o Ken estão a divertir-se imenso no mundo colorido e aparentemente perfeito da Terra da Barbie. No entanto, quando têm a oportunidade de ir para o mundo real, depressa descobrem as alegrias e os perigos de viver entre os humanos.

programme.title: Astérix And Obélix: O Império do Meio
programme.desc: A única filha do imperador chinês Han Xuandi foge de um príncipe severo e procura a ajuda dos gauleses e dos dois bravos guerreiros Astérix e Obélix.

programme.title: Agentes Secundários
programme.desc: Dois polícias falhados são enviados para o liceu como agentes infiltrados, com a missão de se integrarem e apreenderem uma nova droga sintética que circula entre os adolescentes.

programme.title: Agentes Universitários
programme.desc: Os agentes Schmidt e Jenko voltam a trabalhar infiltrados agora numa universidade. Mas quando Jenko encontra uma alma caridosa na equipa de futebol americano e Schmidt conhece a cena artística da escola, os dois parceiros começam a duvidar da sua amizade.

programme.title: Cândido - O Espião que Veio do Futebol
programme.desc: Um treinador nacional que trabalhava em Lisboa durante a Segunda Guerra Mundial também atuou como espião dos Aliados, levando uma vida dupla arriscada.

programme.title: Pôr do Sol - O Mistério do Colar de São Cajó
programme.desc: A saga da família Bourbon de Linhaça e sua posse mais preciosa: o Colar de São Cajó, que está na família há mais de 3.500 anos e esconde segredos, maldições e uma receita lendária de bacalhau.

programme.title: Gunner
programme.desc: Lee Gunner tenta salvar seus filhos, Luke e Travis, de um perigos0 gangue de traficantes.

programme.title: Vingança Súbita
programme.desc: Ao saber da morte de seu irmão, Shannon retorna ao seu antigo reduto para encontrar os homens responsáveis e fazer justiça com as próprias mãos.

programme.title: Hansel e Gretel: Caçadores de Bruxas
programme.desc: Depois de terem ganho o gosto à caça às bruxas ainda em crianças, Hansel e Gretel tornam-se grandes vigilantes, determinados a retaliar. Mas sem saberem, os dois irmãos passama ser o alvo e terão de enfrentar um mal ainda maior que bruxas: o passado.

programme.title: Robocop 2
programme.desc: Na cidade de Detroit, com a polícia em greve, só Robocop reage, mas um poderoso conglomerado tenta domesticá-lo para atingir a sua estratégia de poder.

programme.title: Aqueles Que Me Desejam a Morte

programme.title: Festa de Natal da Empresa
programme.desc: Quando a diretora-geral tenta encerrar a sucursal do seu irmão folião, ele e o seu diretor-técnico têm de reunir os colegas de trabalho e dar a mais estrondosa festa de Natal, para impressionar um potencial cliente que irá salvar os seus empregos.

programme.title: A-X-L: Uma Amizade Extraordinária
programme.desc: A.X.L. é um cão robótico ultra-secreto e a mais avançada geração de inteligência artificial. Depois de uma experiência falhada, A.X.L. é encontrado no deserto pelo viajante Miles, que cria uma ligação com ele...

programme.title: Mamma Mia!
programme.desc: Decidida a conhecer a identidade do seu pai, uma jovem mulher convida três potenciais progenitores para o seu casamento, contra a vontade da sua mãe.

programme.desc: Quatro anos após a destruição da Isla Nublar, os agentes da Biosyn tentam rastrear Maisie Lockwood, enquanto a Dra. Ellie Sattler investiga um enxame geneticamente modificado de insetos gigantes.

programme.title: Bastille Day - Missão Antiterrorista
programme.desc: Em Paris, um agente da CIA une esforços com um carteirista para impedirem uma conspiração internacional. Numa frenética corrida contra o tempo, o duo apercebe-se que ambos se tornaram alvos a abater e que têm de confiar um no outro para vencer.

programme.title: Prey

programme.desc: Um especialista em proteção contra o envelhecimento assume um último trabalho antes da aposentadoria, protegendo um casal que roubou oito milhões de dólares de uma família criminosa implacável.

programme.desc: Uma adolescente que sofre de ansiedade devido a um evento trágico de seu passado vê- se caçada na floresta por um sociopata em uma fúria assassina.

programme.desc: T in the Park festival is a major Scottish music festival that has been held almost annually since 1994 (the event did not take place in 2017). It is named after its main sponsor, the brewing company Tennents.

programme.title: Charli XCX - Reading And Leeds Festival 2022
programme.desc: The Reading and Leeds Festivals are a pair of music festivals that take place annually in the cities of Reading and Leeds in England. Featuring Charli XCX.

programme.title: Various Artists - iConcerts Hits
programme.desc: A selection of our best concert previews and exclusive interviews.

programme.title: Britney Spears - Live from London
programme.desc: Filmed at Roundhouse, London, this concert film will give all fans a spectacular Live experience from start to finish. Britney Spears performs her hits including 'Baby One More Time', 'Oops! I Did It Again', 'Toxic' and many more.

programme.title: Hollywood Demons T2 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Fraudes, mentiras e cassetes com sexo mancharam a reputação da sitcom do liceu dos anos 90. Amigos, pais e atores revelam as duras realidades.

programme.title: Death By Fame T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: A cantora Christina Grimmie tornou-se uma estrela internacional depois de representar no «The Voice». Porém, a obsessão de um fã desfaz-lhe os sonhos levando a um trágico desfecho.

programme.title: Evil Lives Here: My Child The Killer T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Uma mãe solteira luta para criar o filho e a filha, mas acontece o pior quando descobre que o filho de 13 anos tem um lado negro.

programme.title: People Magazine Investigates T8 - Ep. 12
programme.desc: Em 1975, o Indiana Slasher ataca três jovens, deixa-as a morrer num milheiral e depois desaparece pela noite. Será feita justiça algum dia?.

programme.title: The Playboy Murders T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Depois de se tornar famosa num concurso de beleza, uma modelo da Playboy cria uma ligação com os fãs. Porém, um fã obsessivo vai até mais longe e o mundo dela começa a desabar.

programme.title: Still A Mystery T4 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Em 2017, duas adolescentes saem para passear e nunca mais são vistas. Um rapaz de 13 anos de férias no Colorado desaparece. Resta saber o que lhe aconteceu.

programme.title: Still A Mystery T4 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Depois de uma noitada, Jaleayah Davis, de 20 anos, é encontrada morta. Resta saber se foi um acidente ou algo mais sinistro. Kelsie Schelling sai de casa e não regressa.

programme.title: Evil Lives Here: Shadows Of Death T2 - Ep. 12
programme.desc: O que acontece no rescaldo de um crime que muda a vida das pessoas? Estas são as histórias de como pessoas inocentes são afetadas pelo assassínio muito depois deste ter ocorrido.

programme.title: Evil Lives Here: Shadows Of Death T3 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Em 2004, investigadores procuram um assassino em série que ataca mulheres negras vulneráveis em Peoria, no Illinois. Os afetados pelos assassinatos contam os trágicos eventos.

programme.title: Evil Lives Here T3 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Estephania LeBaron acreditava que a sua família matava em nome de Deus. Mas quando chega a vez dela de cometer as mesmas atrocidades, começa a questionar tudo.

programme.title: Evil Lives Here T3 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: Melissa More adorava o seu pai e achava-o incapaz de fazer mal a alguém. Mas, agora mais velha, o amor paternal dá lugar ao medo de se tornar uma vítima do pai.

programme.title: The Playboy Murders T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Depois de se tornar famosa num concurso de beleza, uma modelo da Playboy cria uma ligação com os fãs. Porém, um fã obsessivo vai até mais longe e o mundo dela começa a desabar.

programme.title: The Playboy Murders T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: O assassinato da cibernética Carlin-Kraft da Playboy leva a polícia a uma busca pelo seu assassino desde as ruas de Filadélfia até a uma ala psiquiátrica.

programme.title: People Magazine Investigates T7 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Em 1982, um homem chega a casa e encontra a mulher morta com um machado na cabeça. A cidade vive com medo do assassino até ser feita, finalmente, uma detenção décadas depois.

programme.title: People Magazine Investigates T7 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Em 2007, uma mulher de 19 anos é brutalmente assassinada numa pequena cidade de Winnsboro, no Texas. A investigação traz a lume alguns dos segredos mais sombrios da cidade.

programme.title: American Monster T2 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Em Albuquerque, Mike Snyder começa uma família com a sua parceira, registando tudo em vídeo Mas quando lhe é diagnosticada uma doença grave, ele desaparece.

programme.title: American Monster T3 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Na Califórnia, um intruso ataca e mata Joan Dawley. Filmagens caseiras secretas desvendam um história de logros, perpetuados por um monstro que se mantinha à parte.

programme.title: Contos Das Estrelinhas
programme.desc: 'Contos das Estrelinhas' é uma série infantil produzida pela KanucaTV, voltada para o público mais jovem. A série apresenta uma série de histórias lúdicas e encantadoras que têm como objetivo ensinar valores importantes para as crianças de maneira divertida e envolvente.

programme.title: Descobrindo A Bíblia
programme.desc: Será que conheces bem a Bíblia? Agora é a tua chance de testar o teu conhecimento e divertires-te como nunca! Com categorias emocionantes e perguntas desafiadoras, cada episódio é uma nova oportunidade de aprender e acertar. Reune a tua família e os teus amigos, e participa no descobrindo a bíblia.

programme.title: Superbook
programme.desc: Conheça Chris e joy, 2 crianças que estão sempre prontas para viver as aventuras do passado com o Superbook. Uma série com muitos ensinamentos bíblicos que vai permitir conhecer a Deus , despertar a curiosidade e fortalecer a fé.

programme.title: Unitel Brilha Com As Estrelinhas (Semana 2)
programme.desc: O concurso que revela talentos infantis gospel e transforma sonhos em música e esperança. Emoção, fé e muito brilho nos palcos de Angola!

programme.title: Família Dumbo
programme.desc: A Família Dumbo chega à Kanuca TV trazendo o retrato divertido e emocionante de uma família típica de Benguela, onde cada episódio transforma desafios do dia-a-dia em histórias cheias de humor, valores e identidade angolana. Entre confusões, gargalhadas e lições inesperadas, a Família Dumbo mostra que em cada casa angolana existe uma história que merece ser contada.

programme.title: Chocolix
programme.desc: Os Chocolix são uma família de chocolates de diversas cores que vivem no esplêndido Reino da Chocolândia. Dona Branca, Don Cacau e seus filhos Chocomark e Chocholyne embarcam em grandes aventuras.

programme.title: Gemini 8
programme.desc: Gemini 8 é uma série animada que narra as aventuras de Marco, um garoto terrestre que, ao ser puxado por uma pipa através de um portal, é transportado para o distante planeta Gemini 8. Apresenta uma mistura de aventura e ficção científica, explorando temas como amizade, exploração e o desconhecido.

programme.title: Já Sei
programme.desc: Explora o mundo do conhecimento com o já sei! De uma forma divertida vais aprender palavras novas todos os dias. Junta os teus amigos e venham se divertir com o desafio das palavras cruzadas. Já sei! O saber não ocupa lugar.

programme.title: Palavras Que Rimam
programme.desc: A cada episódio, explore de maneira divertida e ritmada como pronunciar corretamente palavras que rimam, com muita diversão e aprendizagem. Vai ajudar a pronunciar melhor as palavras. De maneira divertida vai estimular a associação das palavras e desta forma facilitar o teu processo de alfabetização.

programme.title: Vamos Aprender
programme.desc: Aprender ficou mais divertido. De forma cativante e divertida, o VAMOS APRENDER vai levar até ti lições que vão estimular a tua imaginação com uma variedade de temas como cores, frutas, animais, formas e muito mais.

programme.title: Mundo Da Kanuca
programme.desc: Embarca numa viagem fascinante pelo incrível Mundo da Kanuca! Aqui vais poder passear pelo jardim mágico, repleto de surpresas doces e brinquedos encantadores. Vais encontrar os mistérios escondidos e desvendar os segredos da kanuca
